executive_summary: A customer (Speaker 1) contacted support regarding an unresolved complaint ticket TK-4821, open for three days. The support agent (Speaker 0) acknowledged the delay, confirmed the ticket is in the escalation queue, and committed to a manager callback within one hour.

Speaker 0: Identified ticket TK-4821 in the escalation queue
Committed to transferring the call to a manager
Guaranteed a callback within one hour
Speaker 1: Raised complaint TK-4821 with no response for three days
Demanded to speak with a manager
Requested a callback within the hour

decisions.context: Customer has been waiting three days without a response
